verdict.rationale: Groq's Responses API documents image inputs alongside text, and the official TypeScript SDK shows audio transcription via whisper-large-v3-turbo with file uploads, so vision and audio models are callable on the same API platform. Missing for 10: any evidence of image-generation models, dedicated vision-model docs beyond a single Responses API mention, text-to-speech or other audio-output evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of multimodal use.
